Scarlet & Violet Black Star Promos

Released January 1, 2023 · 75 cards

StandardExpanded

Scarlet & Violet Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on January 1, 2023. It has 75 cards. It includes 161 Pokémon, 4 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

81 illustrators worked on Scarlet & Violet Black Star Promos. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (18), takuyoa (8), GIDORA (5), aky CG Works (4), GOSSAN (4), PLANETA Mochizuki (4), Anesaki Dynamic (3), Mina Nakai (3).
